Okay but have you ever really watched a cat? Like, really paid attention? They're the weirdest little creatures. One minute they're sleeping in a sunbeam looking like the most peaceful thing on the planet, and the next minute they're sprinting through the house at full speed for absolutely no reason. What are they running from? What did they see? We'll never know!

Dogs, on the other hand, are the most transparent animals alive. Everything they're feeling is right there on their face. Happy? Tail going a million miles an hour. Guilty? They won't look at you and they're definitely sitting next to something they destroyed. You always know where you stand with a dog.

What really gets me is how smart some animals are. Crows can use tools! Octopuses can open jars! Elephants recognize themselves in mirrors! And we're out here acting special because we invented spreadsheets. Sure, spreadsheets are useful, but have you tried opening a jar with eight arms? Didn't think so.

Honestly, animals have it figured out way better than we do. Eat, sleep, hang out, repeat. No meetings, no emails, no existential dread. They're living their best lives and they don't even know it.
